fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Street Frontage; Open Green Space; Storage Area; Detached Structure
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Limited Rear Access; Multiple Structures
fr.recommendations:
Based on the provided observations, here are the responder-safety recommendations:

• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions of travel on the street.
• Post the property address on any detached structure if it has a separate access point from the main residence.
• Keep a clear, unobstructed path between the main residence and the detached structure for responder movement.
• Mark or label the rear access point so responders arriving from the street can quickly identify it.
• Keep the rear access point unlocked or secured with a breakaway lock to allow responder entry without delay.
• Clear the storage area of any items that block the walking path between structures.
• Keep vehicle parking areas clear of overflow vehicles that would block movement between the street and either structure.
• Mark all access points to the property with reflective indicators visible at night.
